sources.description: Pure invented South Pacific positions/times; no real incident or system export
Synthetic source record has no HDG; does not authorize COG fallback
Invented clock: A UTC reference; B source clock 12 seconds slow; alignment adds 12 seconds
Invented IMO/MMSI digit-shape fixtures; invalid IMO check digit, non ordinary ship MID; not registration
